body:
Continuation of incomplete draft PR #1165, roadmap Tasks 13–15. Depends on navigation, account, and paired-host foundations.

## Screens
- Brain, Research, Scheduled Jobs, Webhooks
- Profiles, Cookbook, Review Queue, Report Card
- Email, Gallery, Skills, Playbooks, MCP, Providers/Models

## Acceptance
- Production-owned Email/Gallery remain usable when the Mac is offline
- Paired-Mac tools show secret-free read-only cache while offline
- Webhook secrets are one-time display only and never persisted
- Profile scope preserves null-vs-empty semantics and confirms projection before refresh
- Destructive/run-now/high-risk actions require confirmation/approval
- Every screen handles loading, empty, offline, forbidden, expired-auth, and server error
- Contract/E2E/accessibility/security reviews pass
title: iOS: build dedicated Rhythm agent tool screens
